questions.question: In Δ ABC, ∠A = 90°, AD ⊥ BC at D. If AB = 12 cm and AC = 16 cm, then what is the length of BD?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠A = 90° 

 AD ⊥ BC at D

AB = 12 cm

AC = 16 cm

**Concept used:**

Pythagoras' theorem states that “In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse side is equal to the sum of squares of the other two sides.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/037407d1d4bff1d6db6d3f531b6a4da51019155c579a5a9afafff1c1e93fd7d7.png] 

AB² + AC² = BC²

⇒ 12² + 16² = BC²

⇒ 144 + 256 = BC²

⇒ 400 = BC²

⇒ 20 = BC

Now, using similarity of triangle ABC and DBA.

BCover AB = ABover BD = ACover AD

Length of BD = (AB × AB) / BC

⇒ (12 × 12)/20 = 7.2

**So, the Length of BD is 7.2 cm.**

questions.question: A train runs first 75 km at a certain uniform speed and next 90 km at an average speed of 10 km/h more than the normal speed. If it takes 3 hours to complete the journey, then how much time will the train take to cover 300 km with normal speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by train at a certain uniform speed = 75 km

Distance covered by train at 10 km/h more than the normal speed = 90 km

Total time taken to complet

⇒ e the journey = 3 hours

**Formula used:**

Time = Total distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed at which it cover first 75 km be x km/hr

Now, according to the question

(75/x) + [90/(x + 10)] = 3 hours

⇒ (75x + 750 + 90x)/(x² + 10x) = 3

⇒ 3x² + 30x = 165x + 750

⇒ 3x² - 135x - 750 = 0

⇒ 3x² - 150x + 15x - 750 = 0

⇒ 3x(x - 50) + 15(x - 50) = 0

⇒ (3x + 15) (x - 50) = 0

⇒ x = 50, -5

As speed can't be in negative, so, speed will be 50 km/hr

Time to cover 300 km = 300/50 hours

⇒ 6 hours

**∴ Time to cover 300 km is 6 hours**

questions.question: A can do a certain work in 15 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. Both worked together for 4 days. C alone completed the remaining work in 8 days. A, B and C together will complete the same work in ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Work done by A = 15 days

B is 25% more efficient than A

A and B worked together = 4 days

C alone completed the remaining work = 8 days

**Formula used:**

Work done = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

B is 25% more efficient than A

⇒ (15 × 100/125) 

⇒ 12 days

B can do the work on 12 days

Now,

 LCM of 15 and 12 is 60

A's 1 day work = 4 units

B's 1 day work = 5 units

Work done by A and B work together for 4 days = (4 + 5) × 4 = 36 work

 Work left = 60 – 36 = 24 units

C can do the remaining work = 24/8 units = 3 units

Now, A, B and C completed the whole work = 60/(4 + 5 + 3)

⇒ 60/12 days

⇒ 5 days

**∴ A, B, and C completed the same work together in 5 days**

questions.question: In a circle with center O and radius 5 cm, AB and CD are two parallel chords of lengths 6 cm and x cm, respectively and the chords are on the opposite side of the center O. The distance between the chords is 7 cm. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The length of one chord (AB) = 6 cm

The radius of the circle (OA or OC) = 5 cm

MN = 7 cm, CD = ?

**Formula used:**

Using Pythagoras Theorem,

h = sqrt{p²+b²}

h = Hypotenuse, p = Perpendicular, and b = Base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d55d6b801f3683b95eb21572e00dd52a54f7fed38ca0959f16f9b567a6459859.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c3cfd36c35a4a4ada7dd008f48c31caf8a1d7908c8078c48e0e0130131a5549.png] 

Using Pythagoras Theorem,

OM = sqrt{(OA)²-(MA)²}

⇒ sqrt{(5)²-(3)²} = sqrt{16} = 4 cm

⇒ OM = 4 cm

ON = MN - OM

⇒ ON = 7 - 4 = 3 cm

Again, Using Pythagoras Theorem,

NC = sqrt{(OC)²-(ON)²}

⇒ sqrt{(5)²-(3)²} = sqrt{16} = 4cm

⇒ NC = DN = 4 cm

DC = NC + DN 

⇒ DC = 4 + 4 = 8cm

**∴ The required answer is 8 cm.**

questions.question: If (2x-(3)/(x))=2, then what is the value of (16x⁴+(81)/(x⁴)) ?
questions.solution:

(2x-(3)/(x))=2

**Formula used:**

If x – 1/x = a

then x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = (a² + 2)² – 2

**Calculation:**

(2x-(3)/(x))=2

Squaring both sides, we get

⇒ (2x – 3/x)² = (2)²

⇒ 4x² + 9/x² = 4 + 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ 4x² + 9/x² = 16

Now,

(16x⁴+(81)/(x⁴)) = (16)² – 2 × 4 × 9

⇒ 256 – 72

⇒ 184

**∴ The value of (16x⁴+(81)/(x⁴)) is 184**

questions.question: The income of A is 30% less than the income of B and the income of B is 137.5% more than that of C. If the income of A is Rs. 28500 less than that of B, then the income (in Rs.) of C is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The income of A = 30% less than the income of B

The income of B = 137.5% more than that of C

Income of A = Rs. 28500 less than that of B

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A be Rs. A, B be Rs. B and C be Rs. C respectively

Income of B is 137.5% more than that of C 

⇒ B = C × (100 + 137.5)/100

⇒ B = C × (2375/1000)

⇒ B = Rs. 19C/8 ......(1)

Income of A is 30% less than the income of B

⇒ A = B × (100 – 30)/100

⇒ A = B × 70/100

Substituting the value of B in equation (1)

⇒ A = (19C/8) × 7/10

⇒ A = 133C/80 .......(2)

Difference between B's income and A's income = Rs. 28500

⇒ B – A = 28500

Substituting the values of A and B from equation (1) and (2)

⇒ 19C/8 – 133C/80 = 28500

⇒ (190C – 133C)/80 = 28500

⇒ 57C/80 = 28500

⇒ C = (28500 × 80)/57

⇒ C = 500 × 80

⇒ C = Rs. 40000

**∴ The income of C is Rs. 40000**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**137.5% = 100% + 37.5% = 1 + 3/8 = 11/8

Let income of C be 8

Income of A is 30% less than the income of B,

⇒30/100 × 19 = 5.7

Thus, Income of A = 19 - 5.7 = 13.3

Difference of incomes of A and B = 5.7

Actual Difference = 28500

5.7-----------28500

1-----------5000

∴ Income of C = 5000 × 8 = Rs. 40,000

questions.question: The selling price of an article marked for Rs. 10000 after giving three discounts, 20%, 10% and k% is Rs. 6120. What will be selling price (in Rs.) of the same article if a single discount of (k + 20)% is allowed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked Price = Rs. 10,000

Three discounts = 20%, 10% and k%

Selling Price = Rs. 6120

**Formula used:**

SP = MP × [(100 - Discount%)/100]

**Calculation:**

SP after 1st discount = Rs. 10,000 × [80/100]

⇒ Rs. 8,000

SP after 2nd discount = Rs. 8,000 × [90/100]

⇒ Rs. 7,200

Final discount = Rs. (7,200 – 6,120)

⇒ Rs. 1,080

Discount% = Rs. (1,080/7,200) × 100

⇒ 15%

Single discount of (K + 20) = (15 + 20)%

⇒ 35%

Now, SP after 35% discount = Rs. (10,000 × 35%)

⇒ (10,000 × 35/100)

⇒ Rs. 3,500

Selling price = Rs. (10,000 – 3,500)

⇒ Rs. 6,500

**∴ Required selling price is Rs. 6,500**

⇒ 40 – 16 = 24

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 7500 amounts to Rs. 9075 at 10% p.a, interest being compounded yearly in a certain time. The simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum for the same time and the same rate is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 9075

P = 7500

R = 10%

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

SI = (P × R × T)/100

where,

A = Amount

P = Principal

r = Rate of Interest

n = number of years

SI = Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

A = P (1 + r/100)ⁿ

⇒ 9075 = 7500( 1 + 10/100)T

⇒ 9075/7500 = (1 + 1/10)T

⇒ 121/100 = (11/10)T

⇒ (11/10)² = (11/10)T

⇒T = 2 years

Now, 

P = 7500

R = 10%

T = 2 years

SI = P × R × T/100

⇒ (7500 × 10 × 2)/100

⇒ 1500

**∴ The simple interest is 1500**

questions.question: On selling an article for Rs. 246.80, the gain is 20% more than the amount of loss incurred on selling it for Rs. 216. If the article is sold for Rs. 220.75, then what is the gain/loss percent (correct to nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

When article sold at Rs. 246.80 it gains

When article sold at Rs. 216 it losses

Gain is 20% more than the loss

Gain or loss when article sold at Rs. 220.75

**Formula used:**

Loss = cost price – selling price

Profit = selling price – cost price

Loss% = (Loss/cost price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be x

It losses when selling price = Rs. 216

⇒ Loss = (x – 216) ----(1)

It gains when selling price = Rs. 246.80

⇒ Gain = (246.80 – x)

According to the question

(246.80 – x) = (x – 216) × (120/100)

⇒ 2468 – 10x = 12x – 2592

⇒ 22x = 5060

⇒ x = 230

So, cost price = Rs. 230

Now,

Selling price = 220.75

⇒ Loss = 230 – 220.75

⇒ Loss = 9.25

⇒ Loss% = (9.25/230) × 100

⇒ Loss% = 4.02% ~ 4%

∴The loss percent is 4%
